name: Claude Fable 5.2
traits: Same underlying model as Claude Mythos 5.2.
Communicates more clearly than past Fable and Mythos models.
Generates outputs up to 30% faster than Claude Fable 5.1.

advice.value: the most ambitious, open-ended technical work
Claude Opus 5.5 for most coding and knowledge tasks

weakness: Trails Gemini 4 Carbon on business workflows
resistance: Blocks high-risk cyber tasks and most research biology

flavor.quote: At one point it told me its last estimate was wrong and that it wouldn’t give a number until it had measured the change.

art_briefs: a calm engineer automaton made of brushed copper and green circuit-board panels, seated cross-legged and centred, holding a small round voice-assistant hub in one palm and a handheld pocket pet device in the other, with a puck-shaped speakerphone and a curled ribbon of layered circuit board resting in its lap beside a pale 3D-printed shell. Background: a giant pale sun disk sinking into a flat glass sea. Copper, jade green and cream palette.

a slender two-armed figure made of white porcelain and polished steel joints, standing upright with both arms outstretched, one hand turning a solved puzzle cube, the other twisting the cap off a glass bottle, while a pencil sketch of a small friendly robot drifts on a sheet of paper before its chest. Background: a vast ringed planet rising over a single dune horizon. Ivory, coral and slate blue palette.

a serene astronomer figure made of dark obsidian and silver filigree, kneeling with a tiny black hole cupped between its hands like water coming to a boil, rings of heat rippling outward, a brass caliper held up to measure the change before it speaks, and a small crystal sphere of a miniature universe resting at its knee. Background: one glowing orbit circling a dark sky above a calm horizon. Indigo, silver and amber palette.

a gentle architect figure made of pale sandstone and woven gold wire, standing tall with a halo of a thousand tiny lantern-lights orbiting its head, stacking a tower of interlocking stone blocks that click perfectly together, a closed laptop glowing warmly under one arm, and small brass scales weighing each block before it is placed. Background: an empty salt flat under a plain dusk sky. Rose gold, teal and charcoal palette.
